title: How to enable OOP calibration?
symptom: The user cannot enable OOP calibration because the checkbox is always grayed out. They ask for step-by-step instructions to enable this feature.
cause: The feature is not supported; it is a pre-alpha feature with serious drawbacks if enabled.
fix: No supported fix is provided. A workaround is to edit the xDrip+ settings XML file, changing the value of 'calibrate_external_libre_algorithm' from 'false' to 'true', then loading the settings back.
evidence_quote: As a workaround, I could toggle this checkbox by saving xDrip+ settings to XML, editing the value of option "calibrate_external_libre_algorithm" from "false" to "true" and loading the settings back.
